```artifact
Feature: Doctor's Consultation and Prescription Process

  Scenario Outline: Doctor views and manages appointments and consultations

    Given a doctor has logged into the system
    When viewing pending appointments
    Then the doctor should see a list of pending consultations

    Given a doctor has logged into the system
    When providing consultation for an appointment
    Then the doctor should be able to prescribe medicines

    Given a doctor has logged into the system
    When prescribing lab tests during consultation
    Then the lab test should be created and requested

    Given a doctor has logged into the system
    When prescribing medicines during consultation
    Then the medicines should be requested to the concerned chemist
    Given a doctor has logged into the system
    When performing lab tests
    Then the lab reports should be updated offline
    Given a doctor has logged into the system
    When releasing lab reports
    Then the lab report should be available for viewing offline

  Examples:
    | Appointment Status | Expected Outcome                                  |
    | Pending            | Doctor sees a list of pending consultations       |
    | Active             | Doctor does not see pending consultations       |
    | Completed          | Doctor does not see pending consultations       |
    | Invalid Status     | Error: Invalid appointment status              |

    | Prescription Status | Expected Outcome                                  |
    | Prescribed         | Doctor prescribes medicines                      |
    | Not Prescribed     | Error: No prescription provided                |
    | Invalid Prescription | Error: Invalid prescription status            |

    | Lab Test Status      | Expected Outcome                                  |
    | Created            | Lab test is created and requested                   |
    | Not Created        | Error: Lab test not created                       |
    | Lab Test Requested   | Error: Lab test not requested                      |
    | Lab Test Not Requested | Error: Lab test not requested                      |
    | Medicines Status     | Expected Outcome                                  |
    | Requested           | Medicines are requested to the concerned chemist |
    | Not Requested       | Error: Medicines not requested                     |
    | Lab Report Status     | Expected Outcome                                  |
    | Updated            | Lab reports are updated offline                     |
    | Not Updated        | Error: Lab reports not updated                      |
    | Lab Report Available | Expected Outcome                                  |
    | Not Available       | Error: Lab report not available                     |

  Scenario Outline: Doctor's Lab Test and Medication Management

    Given a doctor has logged into the system
    When performing lab tests
    Then the lab reports should be updated offline
    Given a doctor has logged into the system
    When releasing lab reports
    Then the lab report should be available for viewing offline

    Examples:
    | Lab Test Status | Expected Outcome                                  |
    | Performed          | Lab reports are updated offline                     |
    | Not Performed      | Error: Lab reports not updated                      |
    | Lab Report Available | Expected Outcome                                  |
    | Not Available       | Error: Lab report not available                     |

  Scenario Outline: Doctor's Medication Management

    Given a doctor has logged into the system
    When prescribing medicines
    Then the medicines should be requested to the concerned chemist
    Given a doctor has logged into the system
    When releasing medicines
    Then the medicines should be available for viewing offline
    Examples:
    | Medicines Status | Expected Outcome                                  |
    | Requested           | Medicines are requested to the concerned chemist |
    | Not Requested       | Error: Medicines not requested                     |

```
